　光明指引

南无西方极乐世界大慈大悲阿弥陀佛
南无西方极乐世界大慈大悲阿弥陀佛
南无西方极乐世界大慈大悲阿弥陀佛
从这里一直向西去，要经过十万亿那么多的佛世界（十万亿个三千大千世界）后，
那儿有一个佛世界，世界的名号称为极乐。
极乐佛国的佛主名号，称为阿弥陀佛。
就是在现在，这尊阿弥陀佛还正在为大众说法呢！
舍利弗，那个佛国为甚么会称为“极乐”呢？
因为在那个国土里的一切众生，没有种种痛苦与危难，
只会在生活上、精神上享受其他一切世界所没有的种种快乐，
所以称为“极乐”。另外，在极乐国土中，
有用金、银、琉璃、水晶为材料化成的，精巧的栏杆、
瑰丽的罗网和排列整齐的'行树'。
这些栏杆、罗网和行树，呈现出种种有序的、美妙的几何图形，
排列围绕着极乐国土里所有的建筑物，
如亭台、楼阁、讲堂、花园等，使这些建筑物更加美观庄严。
再有，在极乐国土中，
有用金、银、琉璃、水晶、砗磲、红真珠、玛瑙等七宝所化成和装饰的宝池，
里面充满了八功德水。在池子底部，纯粹以金子化成的细沙软软地铺在池底。
在池子的四周，有用金、银、琉璃、水晶交互化成的阶梯和通道。
它们有的或是用金子作地，其他三种材料作为装饰品点缀在阶梯和通道上；
有的或是用水晶作地，其他三种材料作为装饰品点缀在阶梯和通道上等等。
在池子边上、阶梯或通道中间，还有用七宝化成的楼阁。
它们也是以七宝中的一种作为主材料，其它作为装饰材料来装饰的。
所以既不显得呆板，也不显得零乱，一切都是那么整齐有序而又富于美观价值。
在池子里，自然化现出种种莲花。这些莲花团团圆圆，非常整齐。
莲花的大小不一，大的非常大，直径甚至达到有几十里或更大。
莲花的颜色也异常绚丽，有兰色的、黄色的、红色的、白色的等等。
tgt:
Namo the Western Land of Ultimate Bliss, Great Merciful and Great Compassionate Amitabha
Namo the Western Land of Ultimate Bliss, Great Merciful and Great Compassionate Amitabha
Namo the Western Land of Ultimate Bliss, Great Merciful and Great Compassionate Amitabha
From here, going straight west, one must pass through ten trillion Buddha-worlds (ten trillion three-thousand great thousand worlds),
and then there is a Buddha-land whose name is called Ultimate Bliss.
The Buddha presiding over the Land of Ultimate Bliss is named Amitabha.
Even now, this Amitabha Buddha is still teaching the assembly!
Shariputra, why is that Buddha-land called "Ultimate Bliss"?
Because all sentient beings in that land have none of the various sufferings and dangers,
and enjoy in life and in spirit all kinds of happiness that no other world has,
therefore it is called "Ultimate Bliss." Moreover, in the Land of Ultimate Bliss,
there are exquisite railings, splendid nets, and neatly arranged "rows of trees"
transformed from gold, silver, lapis lazuli, and crystal.
These railings, nets, and rows of trees display all kinds of orderly, wonderful geometric patterns,
arranged around all the buildings in the Land of Ultimate Bliss,
such as pavilions, terraces, towers, lecture halls, gardens, and so on, making these buildings more beautiful and majestic.
Furthermore, in the Land of Ultimate Bliss,
there are jewel ponds transformed and adorned with the seven treasures: gold, silver, lapis lazuli, crystal, mother-of-pearl, red pearl, and agate,
filled with the water of eight excellent qualities. At the bottom of the ponds, fine sand made purely of gold lies softly spread across the bottom.
Around the ponds are steps and walkways transformed from gold, silver, lapis lazuli, and crystal in alternating combinations.
Some have gold as the ground, with the other three materials as ornaments adorning the steps and walkways;
some have crystal as the ground, with the other three materials as ornaments adorning the steps and walkways, and so on.
Beside the ponds and among the steps or walkways, there are also towers transformed from the seven treasures.
They too use one of the seven treasures as the primary material and the others as decorative materials.
So they neither appear rigid nor chaotic; everything is so neat, orderly, and rich in beauty.
In the ponds, all kinds of lotuses naturally appear. These lotuses are round and full, very neat.
The lotuses vary in size; the large ones are very large, with diameters reaching dozens of miles or even greater.
The colors of the lotuses are also exceptionally brilliant, with blue, yellow, red, white, and so on.

tgt:
Thus have I heard, at one time
The Buddha dwelt in the city of Shravasti,
In the Jeta Grove, with the great bhikshus,
Twelve hundred and fifty in all,
All of them great arhats without outflows.
The Buddha's disciples, dwelling in and upholding,
Skillfully transcending all existence,
Could, within lands, accomplish awesome deportment.
Following the Buddha, they turned the wheel,
Wondrously worthy to receive the bequest.
Strictly pure in Vinaya, they broadly served as models for the three realms.
Their response bodies were immeasurable, saving and liberating living beings,
Rescuing those of the future, transcending all dust and defilement.
Their names were: Shariputra of great wisdom,
Maudgalyayana, Mahakaushthila,
Purnamaitrayaniputra,
Subhuti, Upanishad, and others, who were the leaders.
Again, there were immeasurable pratyekabuddhas and those beyond learning,
Together with those of initial resolve, who came to the Buddha's place, belonging to the bhikshus,
At the summer retreat's self-invitation. Bodhisattvas from the ten directions
Inquired to resolve their doubts, reverently honoring the compassionate and stern one, about to seek the secret meaning.
